design: phase-gated alerts (120d G2 bar): OUT only after the boom; IN only pre-boom / not-end-stage; crossing + re-arm + spacing; hard IN-vs-OUT 21d separation
adoption_rule: per head: capture >= 75% of the phase-gated baseline (F1.0|IN=pre-boom|rearm=p*|space=21d), minimise calls_per_alerted_episode, ties fewer FAs then more capture; F0.5 twin = Strict

config.GET IN: pre-boom gate (run-up vs 120d low below the G2 bar), crossing, re-arm at train-median score, one call per name per 63d
config.GET OUT: boom gate (run-up >= G2 bar) AND price within 2% of its trailing 21d high, crossing, re-arm at the cut, one call per name per 63d
config.separation: no GET IN stands within 21d of any GET OUT (either direction); GET OUT never suppressed
config.rejected: price-escalation re-arm (+bar/2, +bar, +25% between flags): cost 14-20 captures - busts reset prices between episodes
